_0.TextB: The Four Holy Beasts are four Ultimate digimons that reign over the north, south, east, and west of the digital world. Qinglongmon(Lightning), Xuanwumon(Water), Zhuqiaomon(Fire), and Baihumon(Iron), the Four Holy Beasts have, unlike other normal digimons, twelve cores and four eyes respectively.

_3.TextB: They are the three great archangels who are the leaders of all the angelic digimons in the digital world. They are Seraphimon who executes god's law, Cherubimon who protects wisdom and god's area, Ophanimon who delivers god's love. Also, they lead angelic army consists of man-type, animal-type, and woman-type angelic digimons. Seraphimon is the highest of the three, and thus of all the angelic digimons.

Gun using digimons are usually cheerful, whereas Cannon using digimons are taciturn.

The egos of resentment disappeared in the darkness and decided to attack the Digital World to give the Digidestined and the other Digimons in the world of light "the same pain it suffered."

_31.TextA: The Sovereign of the Awakened Four Holy Beasts
_31.TextB: Fanglongmon, the Digimon that oversees the Four Sovereign Digimon and governs the Earth, stands in a neutral position between good and evil. Its massive body boasts absolute hardness.

_32.TextB: Shoutmon X7 turns the desire for peace into power, and every Digimon in the Digital World is in the form of a Final Xros, and the aura flowing from the gold Digizoid is getting bigger and spreading its wings of holy light.

_34.TextA: Holy Spear and Holy Sword of Light
_34.TextB: The hidden form of Gallantmon, clad in armor that shines crimson. Having fully unleashed its power, the armor has absorbed the heat and turned red. The DigiCore, which seals the Digital Hazard, is located in its chest, and when all the power within is released, energy resembling wings can be seen emanating from its back. It wields the Holy Spear of Light, "Gungnir," and the Holy Sword of Light, "Blutgang," both of which are energy-based weapons without a physical form.

_35.TextB: A gathering of powerful Digimon who protect the Digital World. Even when great trials approach, these are the strongest Digimon who defend the Digital World from their respective positions.

_36.TextA: The Goddess of the False Neverland
_36.TextB: Eosmon, the Ultimate-level Digimon born as a singular entity through the actions of a rogue researcher, follows only one directive: "Destroy all that stands in the way."

_37.TextA: Stop The Black Dragon of Destruction!
_37.TextB: GulusGammamon appeared before BloomLordmon and the Chosen Children, who protect the Digital World. To stop The Black Dragon of Destruction, they join forces in battle.

_38.TextB: Digimon Protecting the Forest These fairies guard the forest from those who disturb nature.

_39.TextA: The End, The Ultimate Holy War!
_39.TextB: In the end, ZeedMillenniummon, revived with the soul of darkness. The Chosen Children risk their lives to stand against ZeedMillenniummon before it brings destruction to the world.

_40.TextB:
Imperialdramon: Fighter Mode transforms into the legendary Holy Knight form, powered up by the strength of Omegamon.
It is said to be the ultimate and final form of Imperialdramon, passed down from ancient times, which descends during the great destruction of the ancient Digital World to save it from total collapse.

_41.TextB:
As Kuramon multiply within the digital world and spill into the real world, chaos erupts.
They merge and evolve into Armagemon, a being even stronger than Diablomon… Overwhelmed by Armagemon, Imperialdramon: Fighter Mode gains the power of Omegamon and evolves into Imperialdramon: Paladin Mode.

_42.TextB:
Omegamon Merciful Mode, a being that delivers judgment and salvation to Digimon who have strayed too far from the path to return, is said to strike only those who once possessed a kind heart.
Omegamon Merciful Mode buries the sorrow of parting deep within its heart and brings down the Blade of Departure — a weapon forged to sever bonds in a single, merciful strike.

_43.TextB:
Among the strongest Digimon, not all of them pursue only virtuous justice.
After gathering strength to realize their own sense of justice, some carry out what they believe is justice in the world. For some, the justice of these beings may be seen as evil, while for others, it may be seen as good.

_44.TextB:
There are many evils lurking in the world.
In such a world, there are Guardians who protect peace from evil beings. Guardians use overwhelming power to overcome any trials and fight for the world.

_45.TextB:
Kuzuhamon, who sees the hearts of humans as inherently corrupt and impure, conducts a purification ritual to extract their defilements and turns them into wooden dolls.
To stop such misguided beliefs, Siriusmon stands up to fight against Kuzuhamon.

_46.TextB:
Alphamon seeks to send the infected Digimon that appeared before the DigiDestined back to the Digital World.
Omegamon faces Alphamon with full power, as Alphamon tries to eliminate Meicoomon, the new friend of the DigiDestined.

_47.TextB:
Lucemon is Lucemon : evolve to Wild 2nd Mode and threatens the real world.
Chosen Children and the Ten Warriors rise to face this overwhelming evil. Can they stop Lucemon : Wild 2nd Mode’s real world invasion and protect the world?"

_48.TextB:
We are not old enough to quietly accept the future that has been decided for us.
If it’s to reach greater heights, we can do anything.
This is not a memoir, but a new adventure of us and Digimon.

_49.TextB:
WarGreymon, who struggled against Millenniummon and MetalGarurumon, who protected the chosen children.
However, the evil power was too much for WarGreymon to handle alone, and it was stopped by Goddramon and Holydramon, who reached their ultimate evolution through the power of hope and light.

_50.TextA: Transcending Time, The Beginning of a Legend!
_50.TextB:
The peace of the Digital World was restored by the new legendary Ten Warriors.
Alongside the Ten Warriors, the chosen children saved the Digital World, writing a new myth and a new legend for the Digital World.

_51.TextB:
A gathering of powerful Digimon who protect the Digital World. Even in the face of great trials, they stand strong in their place, guarding the Digital World as the mightiest Digimon.
With the power of Transcendence, they have gained the strength to overcome any challenge

_52.TextB:
Many evils lurk in the world.
Amid such darkness, guardians exist to protect peace from wicked forces. These guardians fight for the world with overwhelming power, overcoming all trials.
With the power of Transcendence, they stand firm to protect the world with unwavering resolve.

_53.TextA: Wings of Temptation and Wings of Justice
_53.TextB:
"Lilithmon X seduces her opponents with her alluring and beautiful appearance, those who fall for her temptation are destined to meet death."
Alphamon: Ouryuken carries his own sense of justice and fulfills his mission as a Royal Knight.
Though they share wings, the directions they strive toward unfold differently.

_54.TextB:
A Devimon that has absorbed Minus Data to its limit, evolved into its Ultimate form.
Once enraged, its intelligence disappears, transforming into a ferocious and uncontrollable form that attacks relentlessly. Digimon caught in the rampage of the berserk DoneDevimon are completely erased without a trace

_55.TextB:
There are Digimon born with an instinct to corrupt or destroy data on networks.
These Digimon have a tendency to modify their surroundings to suit their own living conditions. Due to their capricious and impulsive nature, they are often involved in malicious activities.
As a result, they can cause various abnormalities, which is why they are collectively referred to as Viruses.

_56.TextB:
Vaccine Digimon were initially artificially created to counteract Virus Digimon.
Based on this origin, some Digimon have been observed to possess a natural inclination to attack Virus-type Digimon.
Due to their role in combating Viruses, many of these Digimon are righteous in nature, though there are also exceptions.

_57.TextB:
Abbadomon exists for a singular purpose to transcend good and evil and reduce everything to nothingness.
As it erases all things into nothingness, it consumes both the Digital World and Digimon themselves, leaving behind void-like blinks of emptiness. Ultimately, when Abbadomon appears, the world is plunged into a crisis of destruction and faces inevitable ruin due to its very existence.

_58.TextB: Feeling the void, the core of Abbadomon endlessly devours fear, emptiness, thirst, deprivation, and even sorrow. From depths deeper than Abbadomon’s own abyss, it accumulates the power to reduce all things to nothingness.

_59.TextA: Perfect data, and data of unknown origin
_59.TextB:
By nature, Digimon are born possessing their own attribute.
Unlike Virus-type Digimon, which reshape their surroundings into environments suited to themselves, or Vaccine-type Digimon, which restore environments ruined by such Virus-types, Data-type Digimon are those that adapt themselves to the environments in which they reside.
Data-type Digimon are an attribute that does not actively alter their environment. However, there also exist Digimon that cannot be classified into any known attribute, or that possess no data at all.
Such Digimon are referred to as “Unknown” Digimon.

_60.TextA: The True Form of the Destroyer
_60.TextB:
Inside Abbadomon exists its true form and core entity.
It pursues nothingness, favors nothingness, and rejects everything other than nothingness. After turning all things into nothingness, it is said to erase itself as well, fulfilling its own purpose.

_61.TextB:
Omegamon X and Alphamon possess similar yet distinct powers.
Omegamon X wields Omega Inforce, a power that allows it to instantly read and respond to what lies ahead. In contrast, Alphamon possesses Alpha Inforce, a power that can momentarily rewind past battle time.
Together, these two powers unite them as members of the 13 Royal Knights, who face off against massive foes.

_62.TextB:
It is said that the influence of DigiCore caused by the X-Antibody manifests differently in each Digimon.
In Omegamon’s case, it gained the ability to instantly read and react to the opponent. Lilithmon, on the other hand, obtained a youthful and alluring physique.
Whether even the strengthened, righteous Holy Knight can resist such temptations remains uncertain.

_63.TextB:
In the Digital World, there exist beings with immense power capable of neutralizing others for their own purposes.
Some of these beings are righteous, while others are evil. The scale of each individual’s power is said to be beyond imagination.
